notes: Spec asserts two bullets: (1) session appears in ready within 1s of agent launch and (2) PID bound within 1s. Both phases anchor to recording start (agent launch) and budget 1000ms, unpinned so either the proc-<PID> pre-session row or the <session-id> row may satisfy them. Copilot creates its session DIRECTORY at launch but writes events.jsonl only on the first prompt, so — as with claudecode — the pre-session row is what covers the idle window; the recipe's nudge materializes the transcript but this spec deliberately asserts nothing about it (those bullets live with basic-turn). Observations assert non-zero tokens and cost after the turn: assistant.message carries model+outputTokens, and both models this account can reach are priced. model is left unpinned because --model accepts only "auto" and the router picks per turn.
